pages.title: Monte Carlo Engine
pages.text: Halls of random-number cores that answer by throwing dice: sample enough and the error falls as one over the square root of the count.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Choose how many samples (10³ to 10¹²) and how strongly to importance-sample: the error is σ/√N, and the right proposal cuts σ while a wrong one inflates it. Each erased bit gives off kT·ln 2 at least: cool the cores and the heat falls.
